# Font Studio · 字体工作室
A DeepSeek Harness settings plugin for typography. It keeps the client's existing font controls — si
ze and family for text, code and terminal — and adds text colour, weight, italic, letter spacing and
line height, with a live preview.
DeepSeek Harness 的字体设置插件。保留客户端原有的字号与字体族（正文 / 代码 / 终端三档），并补上文字颜色、字重、斜体、字间距与行高，带实时预览。
## What it adds · 功能
The page lives in **Settings → Font Studio** (left column, next to Appearance).
设置页位于**设置 → 字体工作室**（左栏，「外观」附近）。
| Group | Items | Notes |
| Size · 字号 | Body / Code / Terminal | Stepper. Ranges match the client's own clamp: 10–22 / 10–16 /

10–20 px |
| Family · 字体族 | Body / Code / Terminal | Comma-separated list; empty means the built-in

stack. Quick-pick chips for common fonts |
| Colour · 字体颜色 | Interface / Conversation / Code | Colo

ur picker + hex field + clear |
| Style · 字体风格 | 5 presets + weight, italic, line height, letter spa

cing | Presets: Default, Comfort, Compact, Soft, Emphasis |
| Preview · 预览 | Live sample | Renders C
hinese + Latin, code, and interface text with the current settings |
**Reset · 恢复默认** restores size, family, colour and style in one click.
## Install · 安装
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The package declares `dsh.bundle` and ships a `cordis.patch.yml`, so no build step runs at install t
ime — the bundle is plain JavaScript.
包内声明了 `dsh.bundle` 并提供 `cordis.patch.yml`，安装时不执行任何构建脚本——打包体就是纯 JavaScript。
## How it works · 实现
- **Size and family** are written through the client theme service (`ctx.theme.setFontSize()` / `set
FontFamily()`), the same Host-persisted preference the Appearance page writes. The two surfaces neve

r disagree.
- **Colour** does not overwrite host styles. It re-declares `--dsw-alias-label-primary`
(interface and conversation) and `--shiki-foreground` (code) inside a scoped selector: `:root[data-d

sh-fs-*] body` for the interface, `[data-chat-flow-key]` for chat rows only.
- **Style** is applied
through `data-dsh-fs-*` scope attributes plus `--dsh-fs-*` variables on chat rows. Unloading the plu

gin removes every attribute and variable it added.
- Colour and style persist in `localStorage['dsh-
font-studio.v1']`; size and family are stored by the Host.
## Verification · 验证
The repository ships the checks used during development:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`tools/check.mjs` verifies both dictionaries have the same 63 keys, that the 35 literal and 28 compo
sed keys the component tree requests all exist, and that the stylesheet constant is well formed. `to
ols/smoke.mjs` drives the real component tree with a stub React and a stub Cordis context, then asse
rts that font writes reach the theme service, that out-of-range sizes clamp, that an invalid colour
is refused rather than written, and that disposing the plugin leaves the document with no leftover a
ttributes or variables.
`tools/asar-extract.mjs` and `tools/asar-scan.mjs` read packages inside an Electron `app.asar` from
plain Node. They were used to confirm the host contracts this plugin depends on; they are developmen
t tools and are not part of the published `files` list.
## Known limits · 已知限制
- The interface colour changes every element that reads the primary label token, so it affects the s

idebar and settings too. Use **Conversation colour** to limit the change to chat records.
- Code col
our changes the base foreground only; shiki syntax token colours keep the host palette so highlighti

ng stays legible.
- The family field needs `theme.setFontFamily`. On a host that exposes only the re
ad side, the plugin falls back to writing the `--dsh-font-family-<role>` body variable itself.
